instruction: A candid documentary photograph in a wide shot from a slightly high angle captures an indoor motion capture studio with a red carpeted floor and white walls. The man in the dark polo shirt and blue shorts (R1) stands on the right, facing left and away, leaning forward to touch the arm of the woman in the white patterned t-shirt and blue jeans (R2). The woman (R2) stands on the left, facing slightly right, looking towards the man with a neutral expression. The man (R1) extends his right hand to touch her right forearm. The scene is illuminated by overhead fluorescent lighting, highlighting the red carpet.
